outcome: postpartum packed red blood cell transfusion (pRBCT)
cohort: The study participants were 37,631 women who had vaginal deliveries at a single tertiary medical center between 2012 and 2023.
finding: Admission complete blood count (CBC) parameters, particularly neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and hemoglobin (Hb), alongside maternal factors, help predict the need for postpartum packed red blood cell transfusion (pRBCT) after vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on predicting postpartum packed red blood cell transfusion (pRBCT) following vaginal deliveries, identifying admission CBC parameters and maternal factors as key predictors for this mode of birth.
